headline: Brazil Stocks Slip as Petrobras Declines Ahead of Runoff
summary: Brazil's main stock index fell slightly as state-controlled oil company Petrobras dropped 2.8%, six days before the country's election runoff.
why: Petrobras carries heavy weight in Latin American equity benchmarks, meaning its share price movements directly sway broader regional market indices.

impacts.name: Petroleo Brasileiro SA
impacts.why: A 2.8% decline in Petrobras shares dragged down the broader Brazilian stock index ahead of the political runoff.
